summary: I tested all 4 features this round on the preview copy (Postgres fleet_test, proxy on 8001, API on 8002). All of them work. Backend: vitest 154/154 pass and `npm run typecheck` passes. Late trips API: GET /api/trips?recordedOffline=true returns only #7 and #8 from the seed. A new late trip created as james (clientRef late-test-xyz12345, startedAt 40 min ago, endedAt 20 min ago, 4 jpeg photos) appeared in the filter, and its detail has endReceivedAt and 4 photos. Combining the filter with status and driverId works. Drivers get 403 on the trip list. Photo migration: the dry run reported 3 photos and changed nothing. With --commit it moved 1 data: URI and 1 res.cloudinary.com photo, and both new /api/files/sts-fleet/trips/<uuid>.jpg URLs return 200 image/jpeg. It refused a data:text/plain row, left it unchanged and exited 1. Dashboard test copy: admin and dispatcher both log in. Dashboard, Trips, Drivers, Vehicles and Reports load. The logo loads (naturalWidth 1254) and the feed shows 'Live' over wss /api/socket.io. While the Dashboard was open, a late trip started and ended over the API: it appeared and then left Active Trips with no console errors. Trips page: the 'Recorded offline only' checkbox filters to the late trips. The badge shows only on late clientRef trips, never on #1-#6. The View modal shows 'Start reached office' (trip #7) and both Start and End rows (new trip #13). Driver app (375x667, john): Home shows 4 completed trips and 210.0 mi total. Offline (context.set_offline), after going to Start Trip and back, the same rows and the banner 'No signal - showing trips saved on this phone (updated 11/19/2026 11:02 AM).' appear. A trip completed offline (4 photos via file chooser, geolocation granted) shows 'Waiting to send' as the first row and the total goes to 222.0 mi. Back online, 'Send now' synced it: it became normal row #15 and the pending card and banner went away. One bug: the trip list pagination total is inflated (it existed before this round, but it affects the new filter too). No deprecated Expo packages and no SafeAreaView-from-react-native imports were found.

minor.issue: The pagination total counts joined photo rows, not trips. Trip.findAndCountAll includes hasMany 'photos' without `distinct: true`. Measured: 15 trips gave total=58 and totalPages=3; recordedOffline=true gave total=17 for 4 trips; recordedOffline=true&status=completed&driverId=3 gave total=8 for 2 trips. On the dashboard Trips page this shows 'Page 1 of 3', and Page 2 and 3 are empty. The fix is to add `distinct: true` (and `col: 'id'`) at /app/backend/src/controllers/tripController.ts:78. This bug existed before this round, but the new filter shows it too.
Photo URLs (including driver selfies) can be opened by anyone who has the link, without logging in. The UUID makes them hard to guess. Noting it only; this may be intended.

ui_bugs.issue: OfflineBadge is rendered twice per trip (lines 189 and 225, desktop table plus a hidden responsive layout), so data-testid trip-offline-badge-<id> appears twice. Only one is visible. Tests must use .first or filter on :visible.
The testID becomes 'home-history-pending-pending-<clientRef>' (the prefix is doubled) because the row key is the id 'pending-<ref>'. This is cosmetic.

issues: The 'X mi total' figure is the sum of only the last 10 completed trips (getDriverTrips limit 10) plus pending ones, so 'total' can mislead. Consider 'last 10 trips'.
The header back button (aria-label 'STS Driver App, back') has no testID.

action_items: Add `distinct: true` to Trip.findAndCountAll in getAllTrips (/app/backend/src/controllers/tripController.ts:78) so the pagination total counts trips, not trips x photos. Then rebuild the dashboard if needed (no dashboard code change is required).
Optional: label the driver Home miles as 'last 10 trips', or return a real total.
Optional: render OfflineBadge once, or give the hidden copy a different testID.
critical_code_review_comments: migratePhotos.ts: the order of steps is safe: copy, then update the record, then optionally destroy on Cloudinary. A failure keeps the row, and re-running retries only what failed. --delete-cloudinary was NOT executed, to avoid touching the real Cloudinary account.
migratePhotos.ts calls connectDatabase(), which logs 'Database models synchronized'. Confirm it does not run sync({alter}) against production when the migration runs there.
recordedOffline uses a Sequelize literal with only the constant LATE_ARRIVAL_MINUTES, so there is no injection risk. The 5-minute threshold matches on server and dashboard.

success_rate.backend: 100% (vitest 154/154, typecheck OK, 7/7 API pytest, migration verified)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; 1 pagination bug that existed before this round

seed_data_creation: I created test trips #13 and #14 (james, late) and #15 (john, offline flow), plus their photos and migration test photo rows 51-53. Afterwards I deleted all of them by id and reset vehicle 3 to 25000.0 and vehicle 1 to 15530.0 (the values before testing). The Emergent storage objects uploaded by the tests remain and are not referenced. No seed or user data was changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Driver app web: page.go_back() while offline leaves the SPA (it goes to about:blank). Use the header back button '[aria-label="STS Driver App, back"]' instead. Camera photos on web work through page.expect_file_chooser with /tmp/test_photo.jpg. The regression test is /app/test_reports/regression/test_late_trips.py (it uses vehicle 3; set LATE_REF to a new clientRef if re-running, because a reused ref returns the existing trip).
rca_of_issue: Pagination total: Sequelize findAndCountAll with a hasMany include counts joined rows unless distinct:true is set. The rows themselves are correct because limit uses a subquery.
